title: Managing group balances
summary: Explains how to manage group split balances: view split details to see each member’s owed and paid status, use the activity timeline to verify reminders every 4, and ensure payments are due within 16 days of split creation. Also covers how to follow up as the due date nears or passes, reconcile partial payments, and validate member payment claims.
faqs: How do I check each member’s owed amount and whether it’s been paid?
How can I confirm reminders were sent on the expected 4-interval schedule?
When are payments due after a split is created (what is the 16-day window)?
What should I do as the due date approaches if some members still owe?
If the due date passes and balances remain, how should I decide whether to continue reminders, adjust shares, or close and recreate the split?
If a member says they already paid, how do I verify it in the split details and timeline against the 4/16 schedule?
